newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asiatrust gets $2.0 million loan guarantee.
newsitem.headline: Asiatrust gets $2.0 million loan guarantee.

text.p: The U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) said on Wednesday it signed an agreement with Asiatrust Bank to guarantee 50 percent, or $2.0 million, of a $4.0-million credit facility.
The loan facility will provide financing to small enterprises.

This is the fourth guarantee agreement of Asiatrust with USAID. The bank's most recent previous USAID-guaranteed facility provided over 40 million pesos in credit for some 45 small businesses in various industries, the USAID statement said.
